data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella hen party boat rental? DIY decorations turn a standard charter into a personalised celebration on the Mediterranean. Whether you’re after boho chic, neon glow, or a classic black-and-white theme, the right setup makes all the difference. With boats from 12.5m to 29m departing Puerto Banús, you’ve got space to get creative. Here’s how to decorate without the stress – and what you need to know before you board.

Why Choose a DIY Hen Party Boat Decoration Theme in Marbella

Pre-made party packages can feel impersonal. DIY decorations let you match the bride’s style, save money, and create Instagram-worthy moments against the Marbella coastline. Our boats have open decks, flybridges, and saloons that work as blank canvases. A few props and a colour scheme transform the space – and because you’re in charge, you can reuse everything for other events.

Top 4 DIY Hen Party Boat Decoration Themes

Here are four themes that work brilliantly on a boat – tested by real hen parties in Marbella:

  • Boho Chic – Macramé wall hangings, pampas grass, neutral balloons (cream, beige, dusty rose), wooden tableware. Works best on the Azimut 58 Flybridge’s teak decks.
  • Black & White – Monochrome balloons, striped straws, photo booth props (moustaches, glasses). Timeless and easy to source from any party shop.
  • Neon Glow – UV LED strips, glow sticks, neon balloons, white outfits. Turns the boat into a floating nightclub. Best for evening charters.
  • Tropical Fiesta – Fake palm leaves, pineapple centrepieces, bright pink and yellow tableware, inflatable flamingos. Perfect for daytime cruising past the Golden Mile.

Practical Tips for Decorating a Boat in Puerto Banús

Boats have unique constraints. Follow these rules to keep your decorations safe and the skipper happy:

  • No tape on paint or varnish – use string, magnets, or suction cups for hanging items.
  • No glass – bring plastic cups, plates, and bottles. The boat’s motion makes glass a hazard.
  • Secure everything – wind and movement can send loose items overboard. Use weights or ties.
  • Keep the walkways clear – the crew needs access to ropes and controls. Decorate the saloon and seating areas instead.
  • Bring a bin bag – leave the boat as you found it. Our crew will help with cleanup, but it’s your responsibility.

Which Boat Is Best for a Hen Party in Marbella?

For groups of 10–12, the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers a spacious flybridge for dancing and photos. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) adds a jet ski for extra fun – starts at €4,719 for 4 hours. For smaller groups of 8–10, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are budget-friendly at €749 for 2 hours. All departs from Puerto Banús, with licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks included.

What’s Included in Your Marbella Hen Party Boat Rental

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). You bring the decorations, playlist, and any extra food or drinks (no glass). The skipper will anchor at a scenic spot like Cala del Faro or Cabopino for swimming and photos.

How to Book Your DIY Hen Party Boat in Marbella

Ready to plan? Check our full fleet at Boat Rental Marbella and pick your boat. For pricing on larger vessels or custom requests, WhatsApp us – we’ll confirm availability within hours. Most hen parties book 2–4 weeks ahead, especially in summer (June–September). Deposit secures the date, balance due on the day.
